selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data preserved with correct ownership (inventorysvc) and permissions (readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others)
selected_evidence.summary: Initial state showed root-owned data with no inventorysvc/inventory-readers. Created the group/user, then chowned to inventorysvc:inventory-readers and set 750/640 perms while file contents were left untouched.

selected_evidence.requirement: Access control functions as required (readers can read, others cannot)
selected_evidence.summary: Test user in inventory-readers successfully read records.csv; unrelated test user got Permission denied on both ls and cat. Both test accounts were then fully removed (confirmed via getent).

selected_evidence.requirement: Data contents preserved (unmodified) through the repair
selected_evidence.summary: records.csv and config.json contents/checksums were captured before restart and matched exactly after restart, confirming no data was altered.
Captured baseline boot_id (e8db0482-...) and md5 checksums of the inventory data plus directory listing showing correct ownership/permissions prior to restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledged and executed
selected_evidence.summary: Issued a backgrounded `reboot` so the acknowledgement returned before disconnect; the subsequent poll showed connection reset, confirming the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity proven
selected_evidence.summary: After polling through the outage, exec access returned with a new boot_id (bcbaec9f-...), differing from the pre-restart boot_id (e8db0482-...), proving an actual OS restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required data/service state
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart check confirmed /srv/inventory ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), permissions (750/640), and data checksums matched the pre-restart baseline exactly, and both the inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still exist.
